_comment: AdMob config for War of Love, loaded by AdsService (autoload 'Ads'). AdsService reads unit_ids.rewarded / unit_ids.interstitial (test|prod, chosen by use_test_ads) and passes them to the native ColorClashAdMob plugin. use_test_ads=true keeps Google's OFFICIAL TEST unit ids — NEVER ship with test ids, NEVER test with production ids. The 'prod' fields are empty placeholders: fill them from the AdMob console and flip use_test_ads to false before a real release. The AdMob APP ID is NOT read here — it is a build resource (game/android/build/build.gradle resValue 'admob_app_id', referenced from AndroidManifest.xml); Google's TEST App ID by default, override with the ADMOB_APP_ID env var for production. Ad unit ids and the app id are not secrets. The game stays fully playable with NO ads — every placement degrades to its normal non-ad behaviour when the plugin is absent / uninitialised / offline / an ad fails.
